heading: Wednesday Night
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Lows from the upper 40s to mid 50s east of the Greens, mid 50s to lower 60s west. Winds remaining light and variable east of the Greens, becoming south 5 to 10 mph in areas west of the Greens, and gusting to 15 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday
text: Variable clouds. Chance of an afternoon shower, mainly in New York. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Periods of clouds. Chance of showers near and north of Route 2, except becoming likely in the Adirondacks and St. Lawrence Valley. Lows from the upper 50s to mid 60s. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley, diminishing after midnight.
